title: Ukuphishekela Inkantolo
intro: Emaphasejini amandla, umuntu onesikhundla esiphakeme wathandana nenceku eyayinobuhle obuhlukile. Lokhu kuthandana kwaholela ochungechungeni lwezehlakalo ezazizovivinya ukwethembeka, zembule amaqiniso afihliwe, futhi ekugcineni ziqinisekise ubumsulwa benceku.
clues: Bengihlala ezweni laseNayile, esigodlweni esinethonya elikhulu.
Insizwa ethile yangena endlini yami, futhi ukuba khona kwayo kwangiphazamisa.
Ngazama ukumyenga, kodwa wafuna isiphephelo eNkosini yakhe.
Ngaklebhula ingubo yakhe ngemuva, kodwa ubufakazi bakhomba ekukhohliseni kwami.
Ukuze ngithulise inhlebo yabesifazane abahloniphekile, ngabamema embuthanweni futhi ngababeka izinto ezibukhali ezandleni zabo.
Ekugcineni, ngavuma obala iphutha lami, ngavuma iqiniso phambi kwenkosi.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
